item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":2,"rationale":"The President mandates the Secretary of the Treasury to use statutory authority to make determinations and issue legally consequential orders, regulations, and rulings later, with initiation and reporting deadlines; although the precise instruments are qualified by “as appropriate,” the required result is agency action achieving the memorandum’s specified licensing objectives.","evidence":"you shall make such determinations and issue orders, regulations and rulings, as appropriate, to achieve the objectives stated in this memorandum"}]}
